title: RESTRICTED provenance of one imported recording (datasets/arabic_import.py -> <out>.provenance/provenance.jsonl). Kept outside the dataset directory and never shipped to training hosts: source_sha256 links the record to the file as delivered (e.g. a Telegram voice note). Keyed by consent_id so it is found and deleted with the participant's data (arabic_import.purge_participant; C9).
